notes.title: Version 1.0 - We Have Lift Off!!!
notes.notes:
We are glad to announce that version 1.0 is now available!!!
Party at Marie’s! Drinks are on Jack!!!


First off we would like to thank you for your continued support. Things got derailed so many times over the last few years, but you have stuck with us thus far and for that know that you are truly appreciated.


Then, even after some major bug slaying the possibility of something not working quite as it should still remains. Should you come across something fishy, drop us a line in the forums and we’ll do our best to vent that bad boy as soon as we can.
Do note however that due to how the engine has been slapped together there is a known issue we just can’t get around. Rapid clicking through NPC dialogue after a load crashes the game and none of our squirrels have been able to figure out how to get around this problem permanently.
If you run across this problem, close the error message and hit “Alt” on your keyboard to access the menu bar at the top of the screen. Then select “View” followed by “Reload” to return to the main menu. From there a simple click on “Continue” will get you back to the action faster than a ninja otter in a skillet.


Also, we’re happy to announce that work on Flerynx has started up again, so hopefully we’ll have more to share about that soon. (*Whispers:* We’re busy with the other playable characters and we’re having trouble sitting still long enough to get any real work done without jumping up to squeal and dance around like little kids in a candy store every few minutes.)


And then lastly, remember our launch week 20% discount. Tell your friends, family and that pesky neighbor about StarStruck. Get him out of your hair for a while by dumping him into a choose your own adventure novel with a potential of 160,000+ words. If you’re lucky he might just decide to stay in space and leave your hedges alone.


Thank you for your support once more, we appreciate it.
We hope you enjoy/enjoyed StarStruck.
Keep an eye out for the free OST DLC in the future.
And then the achievements and trading cards after that.


We’ll see you amongst the stars!
Have a stellar day~

notes.title: Update 0.9.1!!!
notes.notes:
Had a few hiccups along the line, but here we are. The long awaited update 0.9.1!!!
So what’s new?

Main menu overhaul
-A continue button has been added to allow you to continue your adventure from your last saved location with the click of a button.
	 Warning! Do not click this button until you’ve at least reached a new save point or manually saved your game first!-You can now access the options menu from the main menu

Manual save feature
-It is now possible to save your game virtually anywhere during your adventures, instead of having to play up to an automatic save point.
	 Warning! Please wait for all text and animations to come to a complete stop before you hit the save button. Doing so before everything comes to a standstill can and will result in problems when you load your progress later. It is how the engine was built and we can’t do anything about it without potentially breaking everything.

Options menu
-StarStruck now has a working options menu you can access from both the main menu and nearly anywhere in the game itself.
This menu allows you to:

 	Set your game to fullscreen or windowed
 	Adjust text speed (default recommended speed is about 80%, 8 stars)
 	Adjust music volume
 	Adjust sound effects volume

Escape menu
Clicking on the "exit" button or hitting “Esc” on your keyboard will now bring you to the escape menu where you can
 	Return to the main menu
 	Exit to desktop
 	Cancel and go back to your adventures
The “End” button on your keyboard will still instantly close your game without saving and without opening any menus. Almost like Alt + F4, but bound to a single button instead.

These features have been tested and should work with no problems up to chapter 3. Testing and fixing any issues with these features is an ongoing process. If you run across any problems please report them in the StarStruck forums on Steam.

Thank you for your support.
Have a stellar day~

notes.title: Upcoming update: 0.9.1
notes.notes:
The power situation for our area has not improved at all, still leaving us in the dark for half the day at the best of times; causing all sorts of delays and inconveniences. This along with the rampant rampage of seasonal sniffles and sneeze storms had us pondering our next steps to world domina- *cough* in regards to our release priorities. As such we have decided to move up the release time frame of update 0.9.1, but even then it is taking longer than we anticipated.

What will 0.9.1 bring to StarStruck?

- A working settings menu.

 	- Fullscreen and windowed toggles
 	- Text speed adjustment slider
 	- Volume controls for both background music and sound effects

- A revamped main menu

 	- A new quick load feature to make the continuation of your adventure easier and less time consuming
 	- Access to the settings menu before you even set off on your intergalactic exploits

And the addition we are the most excited about:

 A manual save feature that allows you to save your journey at the drop of a hat.


Now with the availability of electricity limited and sporadic at times, and the continuous struggle with colds, flu and less savory outbreaks due to the governing body's managerial neglect, we don’t have any predetermined deadline for this update, but hopefully the incoming quality of life additions will leave you salivating and looking forward to when the release finally does drop.

Thank you for your continued support and patience.
Have a stellar day~

notes.title: Patch notes for 23 Mar
notes.notes:
Phew! My neighborhood got hit hard with outages this past month, sometimes leaving us in the dark for more than sixteen (16) hours at a time. . . Bundles of fun that. At least the storms are slowly starting to taper off with winter on the way, so that's one less thing to have to deal with.

So what's new in 0.9.0.3?

- Adjusted the volume of some BGMs and SFXs.
- Added a few new BGMs to scenes that didn't have any.
- Added some new sound effects.
- Fixed typos and other text related problems.
- Fixed a few animations not quite doing what they are supposed to.
- Fixed a few minor issues with dialogue transitions.

Enjoy, and have a stellar day~ =)

notes.title: Patch notes for 7 Feb 2023
notes.notes:
Bringing out a minor update today to address a few issues.

- Some minor tweaks to the main menu to prevent multiple Winter messages from being opened simultaneously.
- Fixed the lingering hotspot when you return to the main menu after going to the loading menu. It will now no longer 'click' you into madness one mouseover at a time.
- Added a warning to the intro regarding save progress and leaving the game before reaching a save point. Now you have been warned!
- Changed Escape to no longer close the game. It will now open up the built in settings menu where applicable along with right-click. The keyboard shortcut to close the game is now set to End (Usually next to Delete).
- Added a message to the end credits.

Thank you for your support.
Have a stellar day! =)
